jobs.description_text: Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military. jobs.description_text: Role: As a Media Analyst, you will support the measurement, reporting, and analysis of paid media campaigns, helping teams understand performance and identify opportunities to optimize media investments. You will partner closely with media, strategy, and account teams to translate campaign objectives into measurable KPIs, monitor performance across channels, and turn data into clear, actionable insights. You will play a key role in ensuring reporting is accurate, consistent, and focused on the metrics that matter most to campaign and business objectives. This role connects media performance to broader marketing goals by identifying trends, evaluating campaign effectiveness, supporting test-and-learn initiatives, and helping teams make data-informed optimization decisions. You will: Media Measurement & Performance Support the development and maintenance of measurement frameworks that connect campaign objectives, media tactics, and KPIs. Analyze campaign performance across paid media channels, including paid search, paid social, display, programmatic, online video, and other digital media. Monitor performance against campaign goals, benchmarks, and historical results. Identify performance trends, opportunities, and areas requiring further investigation. Partner with media teams to provide actionable optimization recommendations. Help establish campaign benchmarks and baselines using historical performance data Reporting & Insights Develop recurring campaign performance reports

Acting as the final quality gate before release, you will collaborate closely with Producers, Designers, Production Artists, Developers, and Creative Teams to identify defects, mitigate risks, and ensure all assets meet established quality standards, client requirements, and technical specifications. This role requires a highly detail-oriented professional with a strong understanding of design fundamentals, digital production workflows, and quality assurance methodologies. You will review a wide range of deliverables including static creatives, video assets, HTML emails, display banners, websites, mobile experiences, and other digital products. Success in this role requires critical thinking, strong communication skills, adaptability, and a continuous learning mindset in a fast-paced production environment.
